# Motion style

**How do zooms, pans and graphics move?** · [all approaches](index.md) · clashes: C2


## Linear (constant speed)
<a id="linear"></a>

Moves start and stop at once and travel at a steady speed.

**Looks like:** A slow steady pan across a landscape photo with no acceleration. It drifts like a security camera; L03 calls it robotic.

**Good at:** fastest to build; steady slow drift on still photos (our take); no keyframe tuning

**Weak at:** looks robotic (L03); abrupt starts and stops

**Best for:** formats reel30, carousel · niches travel · goals speed · effort low

**How:** The default keyframes in CapCut/VN; ffmpeg zoompan with t/d.

**Backed by:** [Khandala pans and push-ins were linear](../topics/effects.md#fx-khandala-linear-moves), [Nothing linear](../topics/effects.md#fx-nothing-linear), [Make motion visible with a dotted trail](../topics/effects.md#fx-trail-visual-proof), [Travel shots: silhouettes, backs, slow-mo](../topics/filming.md#film-travel-shots) · sources KH, L03

## Eased: entrances ease out, exits ease in
<a id="eased"></a>

Entrances arrive fast and brake gently; exits start slow and speed away. Nothing linear.

**Looks like:** A card slides in quickly and settles 'as if set down by a steady hand'; a push-in glides and stops softly. It feels professional without being noticed.

**Good at:** premium feel; natural motion; one prompt fixes it

**Weak at:** a few more keyframe clicks; overshoot on big moves looks wrong

**Best for:** formats reel30, reel60, reel90, yt-short, yt-long, carousel · niches all · goals retention, trust · effort low

**How:** Ease curves on keyframes in Edits/CapCut/VN; an eased expression in ffmpeg; the four-line easing prompt for HyperFrames.

**Backed by:** [Entrances ease out, exits ease in](../topics/effects.md#fx-ease-out-entrances), [Nothing linear](../topics/effects.md#fx-nothing-linear), [The four-line easing prompt](../topics/ai-tools.md#ai-easing-prompt), [Make motion visible with a dotted trail](../topics/effects.md#fx-trail-visual-proof), [Hard cuts; motion only on overlays](../topics/transitions.md#tr-hard-cuts-motion-on-overlays) · sources L03, L06, L07, L08

## Spring with slight overshoot
<a id="spring"></a>

UI cards and text pops overshoot a little and settle back.

**Looks like:** A label pops to 105% and settles to 100%; cards bounce in lightly. Playful and app-like.

**Good at:** UI and text pops; energy; app feel

**Weak at:** too much bounce looks cheap; wrong for big camera moves

**Best for:** formats reel30, reel60, reel90, yt-short · niches tech, all · goals retention · effort low

**How:** The bounce or overshoot preset in CapCut text animations; a spring easing in HyperFrames.

**Backed by:** [UI and text pops: spring with slight overshoot](../topics/effects.md#fx-spring-ui), [Kinetic type: float-ins, glow, pop-ins](../topics/effects.md#fx-kinetic-words), [The four-line easing prompt](../topics/ai-tools.md#ai-easing-prompt), [Make motion visible with a dotted trail](../topics/effects.md#fx-trail-visual-proof) · sources L03, L02, L07

## Static shots, hard cuts
<a id="static-hard-cuts"></a>

No camera moves; motion comes only from cuts (and maybe overlays).

**Looks like:** A locked talking shot with jump cuts. Only the overlay windows move.

**Good at:** speed; clean; no motion to get wrong

**Weak at:** less dynamic; needs pace from content

**Best for:** formats reel30, reel60, yt-long, podcast · niches all · goals speed · effort low

**How:** Cuts only in Edits; overlays get eased motion.

**Backed by:** [Hard cuts; motion only on overlays](../topics/transitions.md#tr-hard-cuts-motion-on-overlays), [Podcast body: long takes, demos as interrupts](../topics/editing.md#edit-podcast-long-takes), [Demo each effect on your own shot](../topics/effects.md#l10-apply-effect-on-yourself), [Nothing linear](../topics/effects.md#fx-nothing-linear), [Make motion visible with a dotted trail](../topics/effects.md#fx-trail-visual-proof) · sources L06, L08

## Mixing
L03's rule mixes them by job: entrances ease out, exits ease in, UI springs. Hard cuts plus eased overlays is L06's mix.

## Rule of thumb
Camera moves and big graphics: eased. Text and UI pops: spring. Speed with no moves: static hard cuts. Linear only as a deliberate choice.
